  - one common Sandpiper 2 (E101) calculator
  - measuring transducers of type E101 pulser or Eltomatic ME01-04

1. 40, 1.6, 2 or 5, 999999 (Floating decimal), 9999 (Floating decimal), 999999 (Floating decimal), V/V+ or C+, Gasoline... (liquids list)

- R117 1995-GB1-11.01, 20 October 2011, Certificate first issued

Actually OIML certificates of conformity before the CS system... The schema says scheme (A|B). The cert doesn't mention. Hmm, but certificates under old system are typically scheme A (type evaluation + test). Actually in OIML-CS, certificates can be issued under Scheme A (requires OIML type evaluation report) or Scheme B (based on national type approval). This cert from 2011 predates OIML-CS (which started 2018?). The "Basic system" was established in 2004. Under the OIML Basic Certificate System, there was one scheme. Hmm. The certificate doesn't state a scheme. I could omit or set null. The instruction says don't fabricate. I'll omit scheme or set to null. Actually the layered schema lists scheme as a field; I'll set "scheme": null? Better to omit if not present. I'll omit.

Actually, let me think. The certificate format "OIML Certificate No R117/1995-GB1-11.01" — this is under the OIML Basic Certificate System for Measuring Instruments (pre-CS).
